# Tono 0.0.66
Build 66 is Build 65's code, published from Tono's own repository rather than a fork of someone else's. Nothing about routing, the kill switch or the app itself changed; if you are on Build 65 you already have every fix this contains, and the update is worth taking only so that later ones reach you from the place they will keep coming from.
- The download and update addresses now point at Tono's own repository. Build 65 was published from a fork, and everything it linked to lived under that fork's name. - The Windows side of the same release moved with it, and its update check no longer goes to an address blocked from mainland China. That does not affect this build; it is the reason the pair moved together.
The privileged helper is unchanged at 3.12.2, so this update does not ask for an administrator password.
